# The path tick, the resolution and the measure, the sandbox close and the role registry. Arguments are temporary variables zin_arg_<name> (E1).
zin_path_resolve = {
	# Arguments (E1): zin_arg_cp (1 to 26), zin_arg_state (1 historical, 2 diverged, 3 skipped), zin_arg_way (the way code: beat x 100 + divergence,
	# 0 when historical or none applies) and zin_arg_m (the magnitude of a diverged resolution; a historical one counts 0, a skipped one
	# constant:zin_path_magnitude.skipped). A checkpoint resolves once; the measure follows. Owners may call it; the tick does for every rule.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_cp = zin_arg_cp }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_state = zin_arg_state }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_way = zin_arg_way }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_m = zin_arg_m }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_cp
	clear_variable = zin_arg_state
	clear_variable = zin_arg_way
	clear_variable = zin_arg_m
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_pr_state = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.historical }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_pr_state = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.skipped }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_pr_cp = 1 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp01 = 0 }

		set_variable = { global.zin_path_cp01_way = zin_pr_way }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_cp01_m = zin_pr_m }

zin_path_measure = {
	# Reads the temporary zin_pr_w and zin_pr_m of zin_path_resolve. points += w x m; resolved weight += w; divergence = 100 x points /
	# max(resolved weight, floor weight), clamped 0 to 100; departure = 100 x points / total weight (only rises); band from the divergence.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_pts = zin_pr_w }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_pr_pts = zin_pr_m }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_path_points = zin_pr_pts }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_path_resolved_weight = zin_pr_w }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_den = global.zin_path_resolved_weight }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_pr_den < 30 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_den = constant:zin_path.floor_weight }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_div = global.zin_path_points }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_pr_div = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_pr_div = zin_pr_den }
	set_variable = { global.zin_path_divergence = zin_pr_div }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_path_divergence min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pr_dep = global.zin_path_points }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_pr_dep = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_pr_dep = constant:zin_path.total_weight }
	set_variable = { global.zin_path_departure = zin_pr_dep }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_path_departure min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_path_divergence value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_band = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_path_divergence value = 30 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_band = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_path_divergence value = 10 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_band = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_band = 0 }
	}
}
zin_path_close = {
	# After an ending (section 10, the sandbox): every pending checkpoint resolves skipped without counting, and the tick stops.
	set_global_flag = zin_path_closed
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp01 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_cp01 = 3 }
		set_global_flag = zin_path_cp01_done
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp02 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_cp02 = 3 }
		set_global_flag = zin_path_cp02_done
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp03 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_path_cp03 = 3 }
		set_global_flag = zin_path_cp03_done
	}
	if = {

zin_path_role_aenor = {
	# R01 The crown of Aenor. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_aenor
					event_target:zin_role_aenor = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_aenor
						zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_aenor_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = AEN
				AEN = {
					zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
				}
			}
			AEN = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_aenor_next }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_aenor_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_aenor_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_aenor_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_aenor_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_aenor } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_aenor }
					event_target:zin_role_aenor = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_aenor }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_aenor_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_aenor }
				log = "ZIN path: role R01 aenor passes to [zin_role_aenor_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_aenor_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_aenor }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_aenor_vacant
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
					always = yes
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					country_event = { id = zin_path.11 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_aenor }
				event_target:zin_role_aenor = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_aenor }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_aenor
			set_global_flag = zin_role_aenor_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_aenor_next
	}
}
zin_path_role_afrit_seat = {
	# R02 The Deliverer's seat. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat
					event_target:zin_role_afrit_seat = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_afrit_seat
						OR = {
							zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
							zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
							has_character = zin_aurevan
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = WOR
				WOR = {
					zin_afrit_is_hub = yes
				}
			}
			WOR = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_afrit_seat_next }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_character = zin_aurevan
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_afrit_seat_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_afrit_eastern_candidate = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = zin_footholds }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_afrit_seat_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_afrit_seat_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_afrit_seat } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat }
					event_target:zin_role_afrit_seat = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_afrit_seat }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_afrit_seat_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_afrit_seat }
				log = "ZIN path: role R02 afrit_seat passes to [zin_role_afrit_seat_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_afrit_seat_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_afrit_seat }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_afrit_seat_vacant
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat }
				event_target:zin_role_afrit_seat = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_afrit_seat }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat
			set_global_flag = zin_role_afrit_seat_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_afrit_seat_next
	}
}
zin_path_role_host = {
	# R03 The Host of Eindil. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_host
					event_target:zin_role_host = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_host
						exists = yes
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
							var:global.zin_eindil_host = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_host }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_host_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = yes
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_host_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_host_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = SEL
					SEL = {
						exists = yes
					}
				}
				SEL = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_host_next }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_host_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_host_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_host } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_host }
					event_target:zin_role_host = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_host }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_host_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_host }
				log = "ZIN path: role R03 host passes to [zin_role_host_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_host_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_host }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_host_vacant
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
					has_global_flag = zin_eindil_host_raised
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					country_event = { id = zin_path.13 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_host }
				event_target:zin_role_host = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_host }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_host
			set_global_flag = zin_role_host_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_host_next
	}
}

zin_path_role_grey_ford_b = {
	# R05 The second crown of the Grey Ford. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b
					event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_b = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_b
						has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
						NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_a }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = GIR
				GIR = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_a }
				}
			}
			GIR = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next }
					has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_a
				}
				event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_a = {
					random_neighbor_country = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
							has_opinion = { target = event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_a value < -25 }
						}
						save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next }
					has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_a
				}
				event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_a = {
					random_neighbor_country = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
							has_opinion = { target = event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_a value < 0 }
						}
						save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next }
					has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_a
				}
				event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_a = {
					random_neighbor_country = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
							always = yes
						}
						save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_b_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_b } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b }
					event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_b = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_b }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_b_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_b }
				log = "ZIN path: role R05 grey_ford_b passes to [zin_role_grey_ford_b_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_b_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_grey_ford_b }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_grey_ford_b_vacant
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b }
				event_target:zin_role_grey_ford_b = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_grey_ford_b }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b
			set_global_flag = zin_role_grey_ford_b_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_grey_ford_b_next
	}
}
zin_path_role_crossing_lead = {
	# R06 The leader of the Western Crossing. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead
					event_target:zin_role_crossing_lead = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_crossing_lead
						has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = GNW
				GNW = {
					exists = yes
				}
			}
			GNW = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_crossing_lead_next }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_crossing_lead_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_crossing_lead_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_crossing_lead } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead }
					event_target:zin_role_crossing_lead = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_crossing_lead }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_crossing_lead_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_crossing_lead }
				log = "ZIN path: role R06 crossing_lead passes to [zin_role_crossing_lead_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_crossing_lead_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_crossing_lead }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_crossing_lead_vacant
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
					has_global_flag = zin_west_council
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					country_event = { id = zin_path.16 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead }
				event_target:zin_role_crossing_lead = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_crossing_lead }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead
			set_global_flag = zin_role_crossing_lead_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_crossing_lead_next
	}
}

			limit = {
				zin_is_volgan = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_volgan_steward_next
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_volgan_steward_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_region_ember_lands
					zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_volgan_steward_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_volgan_steward_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_volgan_steward_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_volgan_steward } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_volgan_steward }
					event_target:zin_role_volgan_steward = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_volgan_steward }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_volgan_steward_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_volgan_steward }
				log = "ZIN path: role R14 volgan_steward passes to [zin_role_volgan_steward_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_volgan_steward_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_volgan_steward }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_volgan_steward_vacant
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_volgan_steward }
				event_target:zin_role_volgan_steward = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_volgan_steward }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_volgan_steward
			set_global_flag = zin_role_volgan_steward_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_volgan_steward_next
	}
}
zin_path_role_parim_holder = {
	# R15 The holder of Parim. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder
					event_target:zin_role_parim_holder = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_parim_holder
						any_controlled_state = {
							OR = {
								zin_is_site_parim = yes
								state = 238
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		zin_aenor_find_parim_realm = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_aenor_parim_realm }
			event_target:zin_aenor_parim_realm = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_controlled_state = {
							OR = {
								zin_is_site_parim = yes
								state = 238
							}
						}
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_parim_holder_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder_next } }
			random_state = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						zin_is_site_parim = yes
						state = 238
					}
					controller = {
						exists = yes
					}
				}
				controller = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_parim_holder_next }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_parim_holder_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_parim_holder } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder }
					event_target:zin_role_parim_holder = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_parim_holder }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_parim_holder_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_parim_holder }
				log = "ZIN path: role R15 parim_holder passes to [zin_role_parim_holder_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_parim_holder_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_parim_holder }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_parim_holder_vacant
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder }
				event_target:zin_role_parim_holder = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_parim_holder }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder
			set_global_flag = zin_role_parim_holder_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_parim_holder_next
	}
}
zin_path_role_ice_host = {
	# R16 The host at the ice. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_ice_host
					event_target:zin_role_ice_host = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_ice_host
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_ice_host }
							var:global.zin_eindil_ice_host = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_ice_host }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_ice_host_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_ice_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_ice_host = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_ice_host_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_ice_host_next } }
			random_state = {
				limit = {
					zin_is_site_eindil_ice = yes
					owner = {
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
					}
				}
				owner = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_ice_host_next }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_ice_host_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_region_cold_lands
					NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_ice_host_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_ice_host_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_ice_host_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_ice_host } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_ice_host }
					event_target:zin_role_ice_host = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_ice_host }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_ice_host_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_ice_host }
				log = "ZIN path: role R16 ice_host passes to [zin_role_ice_host_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_ice_host_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_ice_host }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_ice_host_vacant
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_ice_host }
				event_target:zin_role_ice_host = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_ice_host }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_ice_host
			set_global_flag = zin_role_ice_host_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_ice_host_next
	}
}
zin_path_role_wreck_host = {
	# R17 The host at the wreck. Keeps the holder while it qualifies; else the successor order of alternate_history.md section 8.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host
					event_target:zin_role_wreck_host = {
						exists = yes
						has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_wreck_host
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host }
							var:global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_wreck_host }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next
		set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host }
			var:global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
					}
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_wreck_host_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = HWN
					HWN = {
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
					}
				}
				HWN = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_wreck_host_next }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = NAR
					NAR = {
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
					}
				}
				NAR = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_wreck_host_next }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = VER
					VER = {
						NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
					}
				}
				VER = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_wreck_host_next }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = -1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = zin_region_islands_of_the_south
					NOT = { zin_diplo_is_dark_power = yes }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { num_of_controlled_states > zin_role_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_best = num_of_controlled_states }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_wreck_host_next
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next }
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:zin_role_wreck_host_next = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_role_holder_wreck_host } } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host }
					event_target:zin_role_wreck_host = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_wreck_host }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_role_passed = 1 }
				}
				event_target:zin_role_wreck_host_next = { set_country_flag = zin_role_holder_wreck_host }
				log = "ZIN path: role R17 wreck_host passes to [zin_role_wreck_host_next.GetTag]"
			}
			event_target:zin_role_wreck_host_next = { save_global_event_target_as = zin_role_wreck_host }
			clr_global_flag = zin_role_wreck_host_vacant
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host }
				event_target:zin_role_wreck_host = { clr_country_flag = zin_role_holder_wreck_host }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host
			set_global_flag = zin_role_wreck_host_vacant
		}
		clear_global_event_target = zin_role_wreck_host_next
	}
}
zin_path_resolve_roles = {
	# The role registry (section 8): every role is re-checked once a month and whenever an owner calls its resolver before acting.
	zin_path_role_aenor = yes
	zin_path_role_afrit_seat = yes
	zin_path_role_host = yes
	zin_path_role_gala_host = yes
	zin_path_role_grey_ford_a = yes
	zin_path_role_grey_ford_b = yes
	zin_path_role_crossing_lead = yes
	zin_path_role_leren_crown = yes
	zin_path_role_volgan_target = yes
	zin_path_role_hall_holder = yes
	zin_path_role_stage8_host = yes
	zin_path_role_alleria = yes
	zin_path_role_dragon_keeper = yes
	zin_path_role_volgan_steward = yes
	zin_path_role_parim_holder = yes
	zin_path_role_ice_host = yes
	zin_path_role_wreck_host = yes
	# R13: the eastern candidates are counted, not held.
	set_variable = { global.zin_role_eastern_candidates = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_afrit_eastern_candidate = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_role_eastern_candidates = 1 }
	}
}
zin_path_tick = {
	# Step 8 of the world tick (06 spec, "The path tick"). Roles first, then each pending checkpoint whose predecessors are resolved, in
	# order: skipped, historical or diverged by its rules, diverged at its latest date; the watchdog skips one still pending 30 days later.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_path_closed } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_ending_reached }
			zin_path_close = yes
		}
		else = {
			zin_path_resolve_roles = yes
			# CP01 The peaceful start (weight 0).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp01 = 0 }
					zin_path_cp01_ready = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 0 }
				if = {
					# diverged B01.D2
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_path_start_failed
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 102 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.shifted }
				}
				else_if = {
					# historical
					limit = {
						always = yes
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_pt_state > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cp = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_state = zin_pt_state }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_way = zin_pt_way }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_m = zin_pt_m }
					zin_path_resolve = yes
				}
			}
			# CP02 The man in the ice wakes (weight 2).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp02 = 0 }
					zin_path_cp02_ready = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 0 }
				if = {
					# diverged B03.D1
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_eindil_awake
						has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_eindil_waking option = EARLY }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 301 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.shifted }
				}
				else_if = {
					# diverged B03.D2
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_eindil_awake
						has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_eindil_waking option = LATE }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 302 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.shifted }
				}
				else_if = {
					# historical
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_eindil_awake
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					# the latest date: diverged B03.D3
					limit = {
						zin_path_cp02_due = yes
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 303 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.shifted }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_pt_state > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cp = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_state = zin_pt_state }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_way = zin_pt_way }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_m = zin_pt_m }
					zin_path_resolve = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				# the watchdog: still pending 30 days after the latest date
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp02 = 0 }
					zin_path_cp02_overdue = yes
				}
				log = "ZIN path: checkpoint 02 stalled"
				set_global_flag = zin_path_stalled
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cp = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_state = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_way = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_m = 0 }
				zin_path_resolve = yes
			}
			# CP03 The Grey Ford truce breaks (weight 1).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp03 = 0 }
					zin_path_cp03_ready = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 0 }
				if = {
					# skipped B05.D3
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken }
						OR = {
							has_global_flag = zin_role_grey_ford_a_vacant
							has_global_flag = zin_role_grey_ford_b_vacant
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 503 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					# diverged B05.D1
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_permanent
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 501 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.never_or_opposite }
				}
				else_if = {
					# diverged B05.D2
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken
						NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_awake }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 502 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.shifted }
				}
				else_if = {
					# historical
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					# the latest date: diverged B05.D1
					limit = {
						zin_path_cp03_due = yes
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 501 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = constant:zin_path_magnitude.never_or_opposite }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_pt_state > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cp = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_state = zin_pt_state }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_way = zin_pt_way }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_m = zin_pt_m }
					zin_path_resolve = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				# the watchdog: still pending 30 days after the latest date
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp03 = 0 }
					zin_path_cp03_overdue = yes
				}
				log = "ZIN path: checkpoint 03 stalled"
				set_global_flag = zin_path_stalled
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cp = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_state = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_way = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_m = 0 }
				zin_path_resolve = yes
			}
			# CP04 A war-king of the West makes peace (weight 2).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_path_cp04 = 0 }
					zin_path_cp04_ready = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 0 }
				if = {
					# skipped
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_eindil_lost
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					# historical
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = zin_eindil_war_king
					}
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_state = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_way = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_pt_m = 0 }
				}
				else_if = {
					# diverged B06.D3

				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_m = 0 }
				zin_path_resolve = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
